intro: Candidate pipeline tracking on your Mac does not have to be a source of constant stress or administrative fatigue. As a corporate recruiter, you likely spend your day jumping between LinkedIn, your ATS, and your email inbox, often losing hours to manual data entry and scheduling logistics.

blocks.text: The reality of candidate pipeline tracking

Managing a pipeline requires constant attention to detail. You are juggling sourcing candidates on LinkedIn Recruiter Lite, moving them into your ATS like Workable or Zoho Recruit, and keeping your notes in Notion. This creates a sprawl of browser tabs that makes it difficult to focus on the actual human side of recruiting.

Most recruiters report that the technical setup of their workflow is fragmented. You might have one tab for your sourcing tool, another for your email, and a third for your interview scorecards. When you need to update a candidate status, you have to find the right tab, locate the input field, and manually copy information. This is where you lose your rhythm.
How to optimize your recruitment workflow

To improve your pipeline tracking, start by minimizing the manual overhead of your most common tasks. For example, if you find yourself constantly checking your calendar to see when you are free for an interview, stop relying on your memory. Hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur to check your calendar for the week. Lazur will look at your screen and read back your availability, allowing you to stay in your current app.

Your ATS is the heart of your operation, yet it is often the most cumbersome tool to use. Whether you use Breezy HR or another platform, the interface can be dense. If you are stuck looking for a specific button to move a candidate to the next stage, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur where that button is. Lazur will draw a circle around the correct area on your screen.

This prevents you from clicking through submenus and getting lost in the UI. You can also use Lazur to dictate notes directly into the candidate profile. Hold the fn key and start speaking. Lazur will format your thoughts into clean text at your cursor, helping you complete interview scorecards much faster.

Scheduling interviews is often the biggest administrative burden. Instead of opening your email, drafting a message, and checking your calendar, you can use Lazur to help you draft responses. If you are in Gmail, hold the fn key and dictate your availability. Lazur ensures the text is formatted correctly, so you can send it off to the candidate without delay.

If you are unsure how to use a specific feature in your mail client, such as setting up a signature or managing labels, ask Lazur to guide you. It will provide instructions one click at a time, waiting for you to complete each action before moving to the next. This is much faster than searching through help articles or digging into settings menus.

blocks.text: To avoid these mistakes, keep your workspace clean. Use a tool like SupaSidebar to organize your tabs by role or by candidate. When you have a clear view of your workspace, you are less likely to miss an important update. If you need to perform a quick search for a candidate's LinkedIn profile, use Lazur to open the link for you by voice, keeping your hands on the keyboard.

Notion is a powerful tool for recruiters, especially for storing intake notes and interview scorecards. However, the interface can be overwhelming if you are not familiar with the shortcuts. If you need to add a callout or a table of contents to a candidate's file, ask Lazur to walk you through the process. It will tell you exactly which menu items to select.

As a corporate recruiter, you handle sensitive candidate data. It is your responsibility to follow your employer's rules regarding the storage and handling of this information. Lazur is designed with privacy in mind. It only listens and looks at your screen while you hold the shortcut keys. Your audio and screenshots are never stored and are never used to train AI models.

Always ensure you are logged into your secure corporate environment. Lazur does not have access to your private data and does not store your credentials. Use the tool to assist with your workflow, but remember that you are the final authority on all candidate communications and data entries.

faq.question: Can Lazur fill out my ATS forms for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit files for you. It can guide you through the process, point out where to click, or help you dictate the text you need to enter.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with LinkedIn Recruiter Lite?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur works in any browser on your Mac. You can use it to open links, search the web, or dictate notes while you are viewing candidate profiles in your browser.

faq.question: Is my candidate data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur does not store your screen content or audio. It only processes information while you hold the shortcut keys to answer your questions.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur on Windows?
faq.answer: No. Lazur is currently only available for macOS on both Apple silicon and Intel chips.
